messages:
Ellen (Docs): Quick heads-up  I opened a tiny PR to clean up the Dedicated provisioning page: a couple of broken anchors, an autoscale example using legacy keys, and a TS SDK snippet that needs the new API. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789
Ravi (ENG): which legacy keys? can you paste the old vs new?
Ellen (Docs): old: `scalePolicy` (object) and `tenant_id`. new: `scale_policies` (list) and `tenant_label`. Also the handbook autoscale sample mentions "preemption" but doesn't clarify reserved vs shared pools.
Marta (Infra): dropping a compact YAML we prefer in the handbook (very short):
Marta (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: "reserved-pool"
scale_policies:
  - name: default
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 6
```
Jun (ML): tiny content note: the quantization paragraph references an old model family. Suggest replacing with: "Prefer per-workload quant profiles; run a perf vs quality sweep before applying cluster-wide." One sentence.
Ravi (ENG): SDK note: TS used to call `createDedicatedPool()`. New API is `reserveCapacity()` and returns `{ poolId }`. Please update snippet.
Ellen (Docs): will do. Plan for PR: 1) fix anchors, 2) swap in Marta's trimmed YAML, 3) update TS snippet to use `reserveCapacity` showing `{ poolId }`, 4) add a one-line migration callout at the top, 5) add a 2-bullet eviction precedence note (reserved: not preempted; shared: may be preempted), 6) replace quant paragraph with Jun's sentence.
Ravi (ENG): tiny ask: keep the handbook example under 30 lines and link to an appendix for the longer recipe.
Marta (Infra): will trim comments, move rationale to appendix. Also here's the canonical isolation runbook link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/isolation-handbook (internal)
link-bot: markdown link-check: ok on branch ellen/provisioning-cleanup :white_check_mark:
Ellen (Docs): pushed changes to PR. tagging reviewers now. Thanks all. :seedling:
